title: Exact finite inductive closure / compiler
statement: For distinct positive-weight score atoms obtained by merging duplicate rows, positive-definite retained information, exactly K nonempty cells, and zero-tolerance exact one-point exchange stability, a nearest-centroid rule q_hat(s)=argmin_b (s-mu_b)^T I_hat^{-1}(s-mu_b) exists in positive score dimension, and every such rule reproduces all merged-atom training labels strictly, without a tie breaker.

proof_location.section: D6. Exact finite inductive closure / compiler

role: bridge from finite assignment to deployable classifier
assumptions: coincident score rows merged into distinct atoms
no relocation constraints beyond preserving nonempty cells
positive score dimension, for the existence half only
